title: Atlantid Vault + Escrow
summary: Register an 8004 agent with ATOM, open a policy-gated token vault, then lock a job in escrow and accept it so the vault is paid (minus a protocol fee).
what: Atlantid is two Anchor 0.32.1 programs. agent_vault is gated on an official-devnet 8004 AgentAccount with atom_enabled: initialize_root_config (upgrade authority only), create_vault, update_policy, spend, and withdraw. agent_escrow takes a worker_vault account, locks client tokens, and on accept_work pays the vault ATA minus protocol_fee_bps.
app_note: The page at /dapps/atlantid-programs/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console pointed at agent_vault. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/atlantid-programs. The lab changed declare_id for both programs. agent_escrow.json is also hosted in the same folder. Vault creation uses the official 8004 registry 8oo4J9tB… (not redeployed).

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/atlantid-programs/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already registered 8004 agent CGAqB2P4… (asset J1TstbZR…, ATOM on), created vault FZLnWzHm…, spent and withdrew, then ran escrow job atl-job-1.
try_steps.see: Vault program 8nbe1vQx…, escrow program 8m9ef1Yp…. Vault ATA DoUoyAY1… holds 990_000 after accept_work (1_000_000 minus 100 bps). Escrow ATA was closed.
try_steps.ran: register_with_options 549HzQs8…; initialize_root_config 27vjRYru…; create_vault 5T3E3YnW…; spend 2KNCjsrc…; withdraw 52hk3PiV…; create_escrow 5gBDpEvy…; mark_completed 44R9A9vV…; accept_work 5nE2e2xd…

diagram: official 8004 register_with_options(ATOM) --> create_vault PDA ["vault", owner, agent_asset] --> fund/policy/spend/withdraw; client create_escrow --> worker mark_completed --> client accept_work pays vault ATA minus fee.
innovation: The vault will not open unless a cross-program 8004 AgentAccount for a Metaplex Core asset exists with atom_enabled and matching owner. Escrow payouts go to that vault's ATA, not a raw wallet.
frontend: Generic IDL console at /dapps/atlantid-programs/ (vault IDL). Creating a vault still requires a prior 8004 register_with_options against the official registry, which is not in this IDL.
exercises: Derive the vault PDA from owner + asset and confirm it matches FZLnWzHm…
Explain why a 3_000_000 owner spend succeeded despite a 2_000_000 per-tx cap.
not_covered: set_agent_wallet and cap-enforced spend as the agent wallet
objectives: Identify the Atlantid program ID and relevant PDAs.
Complete one guided transaction on Devnet.
Match program logs to the instruction you intended.
prereqs: A Devnet wallet with practice funds.
Basic program/instruction literacy from Foundations 003 or equivalent.
student_outcome: Derive the Atlantid vault PDA and explain why an owner spend can exceed a per-tx cap that binds the agent wallet.

learning_loop.objective: Inspect vault PDA + spend — then explain owner vs agent cap enforcement.
learning_loop.predict_question: Vault per-tx cap is 2_000_000. The owner spends 3_000_000. What should happen on the owner path?

predict_options.label: Owner spend always fails when above per-tx cap
Owner spend can succeed; the per-tx cap binds the agent wallet path, not every owner spend

learning_loop.predict_why: Atlantid’s lab exercise shows a 3_000_000 owner spend succeeding despite a 2_000_000 per-tx cap — the cap is about agent-enforced spend, not a blanket owner lock. Students must not invent cap-enforced agent spend as completed.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/atlantid-programs/ on Devnet. Derive vault PDA from owner + asset (match FZLnWzHm…). Prefer recorded agent registration + vault proofs. Explain owner vs agent spend rules; note set_agent_wallet / disputes not exercised.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why can an owner spend above per-tx cap while an agent wallet path remains cap-bound?
learning_loop.transfer: Name vault PDA seeds (owner + asset) and one not_covered path (dispute/crank/agent cap spend).
